title: Cash Drawer Training Sign-Off Form
subtitle: A practical observed-practice training sign-off for cash drawer that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations observed-practice training sign-off for cash drawer covering drawer custody and reconciliation, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a cash office or register lead opens one cash drawer record to plan instruction, observe practice, identify knowledge and authority limits, assign follow-up, and acknowledge the resulting work scope; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Drawer training sign-off identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this training sign-off to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

fields.label: Assigned cash office or register lead

blocks.label: Drawer event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Cash Drawer scope and routing context

sections.title: Drawer training plan and learner route
sections.guidance: Define the procedure revision, learning method, practice setting, supervisor, and authorized scope.

blocks.label: Drawer competencies
items: Links drawer, register, operator, and period
Maintains required cash custody and witness controls
Counts denominations and tenders separately
Matches paid-in, paid-out, void, and refund records
Uses the correct POS expected-total source
Performs only authorized recounts
Routes suspicious tenders without accusation
Protects combinations and payment information
Documents variance decisions and research owners
Completes deposit or float handoff

blocks.label: Training and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: This record supports operational reconciliation, not accounting, legal, or fraud conclusions. Do not record safe combinations, reusable credentials, full card or bank data, or unsupported accusations. During a threat, prioritize the approved emergency response and do not confront or pursue. Follow applicable cash, privacy, security, and retention policy and route judgment to the authorized reviewer. This sign-off records observed practice and assigned limits; it is not a license, professional certification, or guarantee of future performance.

sections.title: Drawer coached practice and evidence
sections.guidance: Record the scenario, learner action, observable result, coaching, and next attempt rather than a generic pass mark.

blocks.label: Exception scenarios reviewed
items: Drawer identity or operator disputed
Expected total unavailable
Recount changes the variance
Variance exceeds local review point
Tender appears altered or requires specialist review
Custody transfer cannot be completed

blocks.label: Strengths, repeated errors, prompts required, evidence references, and conditions for another observation

sections.title: Drawer knowledge check, limits, and escalation
sections.guidance: Confirm that the learner can identify sources, stop conditions, authorization limits, escalation owners, and handoff evidence.

blocks.label: Condition and exception knowledge
items: Drawer seal, lock, or assignment mismatch
Starting float differs from transfer record
Cash denomination subtotal error
Non-cash tender or voucher mismatch
Paid-in, paid-out, void, or refund record missing
POS total unavailable or business period incorrect
Variance remains after authorized recount
Deposit or custody transfer incomplete

blocks.label: Knowledge gaps, restricted tasks, retraining topics, interim supervision, and evidence needed

fields.label: Cash Drawer knowledge gaps and limits

sections.title: Drawer work authorization and follow-up plan
sections.guidance: Grant only the observed scope and state the supervision, expiry, reassessment, or restriction that applies.

blocks.label: Training authorization handoff
items: Readiness decision communicated to scheduler
Restricted tasks visible to supervising owner
Procedure version and practice evidence linked
Coach accepted follow-up responsibility
Reassessment date or trigger recorded
Learner can identify the escalation route

sections.title: Drawer outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Drawer closeout controls
items: Final denomination and tender totals recorded
Expected-to-actual variance decision recorded
Deposit or float package identifier linked
Custody transferred to a named recipient
Open investigation or research owner assigned
Cash record stored in the restricted location

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Cash Drawer residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Training Sign-Off closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
